LM-028.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
LM-028.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's [Main] effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

LM-028.question: Can I activate this card's effect if I don't have any blue Digimon cards in my trash?
Can I use this card's effect to play a blue Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from my trash without returning a Digimon card from my trash to the top of the deck?
LM-028.answer:
No, you can't.
You must perform "return 1 blue Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck" whenever possible.

LM-034.question: What does this card's 1st effect do, exactly?
LM-034.answer: To meet color requirements, normally you must have a Digimon or Tamer in your area that's the same color as the corresponding Option card. However, with this effect, this card's color requirements are met when you have a red Digimon or Tamer in the area.

LM-034.question: Does this card's 1st effect mean that this card's color requirements are met even when I have a red Digimon in the breeding area?
LM-034.answer: Yes, the color requirements are met when you have a red Digimon in the breeding area.

P-104.question: When I use this card's effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
P-104.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

P-104.question: Can I use this card's effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
P-104.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

P-138.question: If the 3 cards I reveal from the deck with this card's effect include only a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?
P-138.answer: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

P-138.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and a blue Tamer card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
P-138.answer: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

P-186.question:
My opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or less.
Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect by not choosing a card to delete?
P-186.answer:
No, you can't.
If your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or less, you must choose that card and delete it.

ST7-05.question: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and an opponent’s Digimon are deleted simultaneously. Does this card’s inherited effect activate?
ST7-05.answer: No. This card is placed in your trash before the effect can activate. It’s no longer in your battle area, so it doesn't activate.
